Available July 2022 · Two Double Bedrooms · En-Suite ·

Acorn Properties are delighted to offer for rent this two double bedroom, two bathroom furnished apartment situated on Rosebury Drive, Longbenton. The accommodation comprises entrance hallway, open plan lounge kitchen, master bedroom with en suite, second double bedroom and bathroom. The property is ideally situated for Longbenton Metro Station and all the shops situated at The Boulevard. To view call Acorn Properties today 0191 212 2020.
